findings.title: CPU-bound response build and serialization run on the event loop
findings.description: Description: In `src/manta_trading/api_server/routes/kalshi_timeseries.py:122-125` and `:165-173`, the DB read is correctly offloaded with `run_in_executor`, but `_admit_rows`, `CandlesResponse.build`/`TradesResponse.build`, and `timeseries_response` run synchronously inside the `async def` handlers. `CandlesResponse.build` constructs Pydantic records for up to `API_MAX_BARS_PER_REQUEST` rows (`src/manta_trading/constants.py:1285`), and `src/manta_trading/api_server/serialization.py:38-44` performs `model_dump(mode="json")` plus `orjson.dumps` or `msgpack.packb`; `test/load/test_188_kalshi_api_nfr.py:126-136` records a 34.80 MB ceiling-sized candle response. The Python rules require CPU-bound synchronous work in awaitable functions to be offloaded. This can block all I/O on the loop during large Kalshi responses; move model construction and serialization into the executor/thread path or stream a pre-encoded response.

findings.title: Load-test tier is opt-in and documented as not CI-gated
findings.description: Description: The new load-test module documents at `test/load/test_188_kalshi_api_nfr.py:37-46` that it runs only with `MT_RUN_LOAD_TESTS=1`, that CI wiring is deferred to slice 907, and that “Nothing here is enforced by CI today”; the module-level `pytestmark` at `:80-87` enforces the skip. The Additional Review Rules require CI to gate load tests for code on simulation, network, concurrency, or environment-layer paths. These tests explicitly cover the pool-concurrency and 75,000-row request paths, so a normal local/CI `pytest` can pass without exercising them. Add a CI job or an always-running load-tier subset that executes these tests on the dedicated test cluster.

findings.title: Load-tier prod-URL guard is skipped and not multiline-aware
findings.description: Description: `test/load/test_167_data_status_nfr.py:214-235` implements `test_load_tier_never_references_prod_db_url` as a per-line scan over `splitlines()`; it only fails when a single line contains both the production URL variable and an environment-read marker. That misses the documented multiline case `os.environ.get(\n "VAR")`, while the shared `test/_prod_url_guard.py` module already provides a multiline-aware regex via `prod_url_readers`/`assert_ratchet`. The guard is also in a load-test module skipped unless `MT_RUN_LOAD_TESTS=1`, so the mechanical guard does not run in ordinary pytest runs. `test/load/test_188_kalshi_api_nfr.py:48-50` nevertheless claims this guard “enforces it mechanically.” Use the shared multiline-aware ratchet in an unskipped load-tier guard.

findings.title: Public time-series model documentation contradicts storage semantics
findings.description: Description: `TradesResponse.tape_complete_through` says “Created time of the newest stored trade” at `src/manta_trading/api_server/models/kalshi_timeseries.py:189-193`, but `src/manta_trading/data/kalshi/serve_timeseries.py:123-143` assigns it from `sync_state.watermark_ts`. The schema comments in `src/manta_trading/market/schema/migrations/kalshi.py#KALSHI_MIGRATIONS` and the `read_trade_status`/`effective_tape_floor` docs in `src/manta_trading/data/kalshi/trade_status.py` define that watermark as “complete through this instant,” explicitly not the newest stored trade. The same module also says “fourteen flat stored columns” at `src/manta_trading/api_server/models/kalshi_timeseries.py:1-9`, and `src/manta_trading/data/kalshi/serve_timeseries.py:70-75` says “fourteen value columns,” while `CANDLE_COLUMNS` includes fourteen nested fields plus `volume_fp` and `open_interest_fp`. Fix the model descriptions/docstrings to state the watermark semantics and the sixteen value columns.

findings.title: Wire-model mapping restates repository maps and can silently drop new columns
findings.description: Description: The module docstring at `src/manta_trading/api_server/models/kalshi_timeseries.py:1-9` says a column added to `CANDLE_COLUMNS` is served without an edit, but `_CANDLE_OBJECTS` values are unused and `CandleRecord.from_row` hardcodes nested constructors and flat keys at `:58-96`; a new flat column would be collected into `flat` but ignored by `return cls`, and a new nested object would raise `KeyError`. `TradeRecord.from_row` at `:162-175` likewise hardcodes positional `values[0]` through `values[7]`, while `src/manta_trading/data/kalshi/serve_timeseries.py:37-43` derives `TRADE_VALUE_COLUMNS` from the repository mapping in `src/manta_trading/data/kalshi/trade_repository.py:42-52`. This duplicates mapping logic and weakens the “one value, one source” convention; derive constructors from the shared column maps and add parity tests for both wire models.

findings.title: Factory classmethods do not use `Self`
findings.description: Description: The Python rules require `typing.Self` for factory/fluent classmethod return types. The new factories at `src/manta_trading/api_server/models/kalshi_timeseries.py:75-99` (`CandleRecord.from_row`), `:134-147` (`CandlesResponse.build`), `:162-175` (`TradeRecord.from_row`), and `:205-224` (`TradesResponse.build`) all annotate concrete class names instead of `Self`. On the project’s Python 3.12 target (`pyproject.toml`, `requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"`), use `from typing import Self` and annotate these classmethods as `-> Self` so subclass-preserving factory contracts remain correct under strict type checking.

structured_findings.summary: CPU-bound response build and serialization run on the event loop
Load-test tier is opt-in and documented as not CI-gated
Load-tier prod-URL guard is skipped and not multiline-aware
Public time-series model documentation contradicts storage semantics
Wire-model mapping restates repository maps and can silently drop new columns
